summary: A dial-code block butted against an Input, sharing one outline. It does not pick countries.
useWhen: collecting a phone number where the country calling code matters

useInstead.when: the number is free-form and the code does not matter

countryButtonProps.note: how a country picker is attached — spread your trigger's props here, including the `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded` only the thing owning the popup can set honestly

guarantees: the dial-code trigger is a real <button> with an accessible name
every interaction state is the Input's, reached through the ordinary Input props
requires: `label`, or `aria-label` when no visible label is rendered
`countryLabel` if you change the default — the trigger shows only `+1`, which names a value rather than an action

antiPatterns.dont: expecting the chevron to open a country list
antiPatterns.why: the picker is deliberately not implemented — country data and ordering are editorial application decisions, and Figma specifies no open state. Wire your own through `countryButtonProps`

antiPatterns.dont: wrapping it in your own bordered container
antiPatterns.why: the block and the control already share one outline; a second border reads as two controls
